title: D3ER: Supporting Multi-Modal Recommendation via Disentangle and Distillation-based Dynamic Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2608.25737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incorporating items' information shared among multiple modalities into a fused representation, multi-modal recommendation (MR) has demonstrated documented success than canonical unimodal recommendation. Although several attempts have been made to extract the discriminative information unique in each modality, existing methods suffer from a core limitation: the joint learning of modal-homogeneity discriminative information (HOI) and modal-heterogeneity discriminative information (HEI) tends to weaken their individual effectiveness. translated_title: D3ER：通过解缠与蒸馏的动态集成支持多模态推荐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25737v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将多个模态间共享的物品信息融入融合表示中，多模态推荐（MR）已显示出比传统单模态推荐更显著的成功。尽管已有多种尝试提取每个模态中独特的判别信息，现有方法仍面临一个核心局限：模态同质性判别信息（HOI）和模态异质性判别信息（HEI）的联合学习往往会削弱它们各自的有效性。为解决这一缺陷，我们提出了一种新颖方法，称为基于解缠与蒸馏的动态集成多模态推荐（D3ER）。我们首次将梯度提升引入MR，以形式化交替学习HOI和HEI的优化目标。该设计使专门处理每种类型信息的模型能够专注于其擅长的样本，从而促进特定性。
tldr: 本文提出D3ER方法，首次将梯度提升引入多模态推荐，通过解缠和蒸馏动态集成，交替学习模态同质性和异质性判别信息，以增强各自的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes D3ER, which introduces gradient boosting into multi-modal recommendation for the first time, using disentangle and distillation-based dynamic ensemble to alternately learn modal-homogeneity and modal-heterogeneity discriminative information, enhancing their individual effectiveness.
